## DeskHelper Pro 1.3.11
**New** - **Notifications button on Blackout** — the Blackout Built-in Display row now has a **Notifications…** button. Because blacking out mirrors your display, macOS hides notifications while it's active; the button opens system Notification settings so you can allow them, with a tip explaining why.
**Improvements** - **Easier-to-read menu tips** — hover tooltips in the menu now use a larger font and lay out multi-line explanations as clear paragraphs.
